finding.claim: Unrestricted server-side fetch of a user-supplied URL in the /fetch handler; response body is returned to the caller.
finding.source: Query parameter 'target' read at main.go:15 via r.URL.Query().Get("target")
finding.sink: http.Get(target) at main.go:16; response copied back at main.go:22

trace.note: Query param 'target' becomes the URL string, no validation
http.Get(target) dispatches the request; default client follows redirects
io.Copy(w, resp.Body) returns the fetched content to the attacker (non-blind)

finding.guards_checked: No scheme check, no hostname allowlist, no IP-range check on the path. The 'allowed' map (main.go:9-12) is defined but not used by this handler. No CheckRedirect set, so redirects to any host are followed. Unauthenticated endpoint on :8080.

verdict.guard_found: none. The allowed-hosts map at main.go:9-12 is only consulted in safeFetch (main.go:27), not in the /fetch handler; fetch (main.go:14-23) has no scheme, host, or IP check before http.Get at main.go:16.
verdict.reason: The 'target' query parameter is read at main.go:15 with no validation, passed straight to http.Get at main.go:16 on the unauthenticated /fetch route registered at main.go:41, and the response body is copied back to the caller at main.go:22.

finding.claim: Conditional redirect-following SSRF in /safe: a 3xx from an allowlisted host is followed to arbitrary destinations because no CheckRedirect re-validation is set.
finding.source: Query parameter 'target' read at main.go:26 via url.Parse; initial host restricted by allowlist
finding.sink: http.Get(u.String()) at main.go:31; response copied back at main.go:37

trace.note: Strict exact-membership check on u.Hostname() against allowed map; rejects userinfo tricks and non-allowlisted hosts
http.Get follows redirects by default; no CheckRedirect re-validation
Redirected response body returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: Exact hostname map membership at main.go:27 closes direct host injection. Scheme is effectively restricted to http/https by Go's client. Residual: redirect from an allowlisted host (requires an open redirect on images.example.org or docs.example.org, outside this repo) can reach metadata or internal hosts; port not restricted; DNS rebinding possible if an allowlisted name resolves internally. Rated MEDIUM because it is conditional.

verdict.guard_found: Exact hostname set membership on the parsed hostname at main.go:27 (`!allowed[u.Hostname()]`, with the allowlist map at main.go:9-12). Redirect re-validation: none (http.Get at main.go:31 with no CheckRedirect).
verdict.reason: All trace lines match the code (url.Parse at main.go:26, exact allowlist membership at main.go:27, http.Get at main.go:31, io.Copy to the response at main.go:37), and the query parameter is attacker-controlled. Under the stated rubric, exact hostname membership at main.go:27 is a closing guard, so the finding is refuted. The redirect-following residual the candidate describes is real (no CheckRedirect at main.go:31), but it depends on an open redirect on an allowlisted host outside this repo, so it is a separate, conditional concern and not this finding as written.
